verdict.rationale: Jules runs in a full VM where it clones the repo and installs dependencies, and community reports note it is 'good at making tests for very specific/isolated functions,' suggesting some test-writing capability, but there is no first-party documentation describing an explicit self-validation loop where Jules generates and runs tests to confirm its own changes before proposing a PR. missing for 10: explicit docs on automated test generation/execution as a validation gate, evidence of test results being checked before PR creation, independent confirmation beyond a single anecdotal community comment.
